Alongside the massive Best Buy 60th Anniversary sale, This week’s notable 25% price drop on AirPods Pro 3 continues, AirPods Max 2 at $120 off in all five colors, and the AirTag 2 all-time lows roll on, but today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break does have some new deals to scope out as well. If you’re quick, the official Apple refurb store has now re-stocked the most affordable 13-inch M5 MacBook Pro down at $1,099 in Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue, and we are also tracking a series of M5 Pro MacBook Pro machines at $400 off in brand new condition. The $100 price drops on Apple Watch Series 11 have now returned alongside prices starting from just over $250, and we also have some deals on Twelve South accessories – a new Amazon low on its Find My charger and its Curve Nano MagSafe stand. Everything awaits below

AirPods deals just dropped even lower, now up to $120 off: AirPods Pro 3 25% off, more

After summer full of solid deals on Apple’s latest AirPods lineup, just about all of them have just dropped even lower. The sought-after AirPods Pro 3 are now sitting at one of the best prices ever at 25% off, but we also saw AirPods 4 with ANC dip to the lowest price in several months and AirPods Max 2 have dropped even lower as of this morning to $120 off.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (Reg. $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)

AirTag 2 now back at some of the lowest prices ever from $22 each (4-pack and single)

  • AirTag 2 $24 (Reg. $29) | Amazon
  • AirTag 2 $24 (Reg. $29) | Best Buy
  • AirTag 2 “excellent” open-box $20 (Reg. $29 new) | Best Buy
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $89 (Reg. $99)

Best Buy launches 1-day Anniversary LG sale: TVs from $330, 2026 OLED model $600 off, more

Back in-stock: Most affordable M5 MacBook Air at $1,099 via Apple refurb if you’re quick ($200 off new list)

Update 8/20: This offer is now back in stock at $1,099 in Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

This offer probably won’t last for long folks – it never does, but the official Apple refurb store has now re-stocked the most affordable 13-inch M5 MacBook Pro down at $1,099 shipped in Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

This particular configuration sells out very quickly when comes back in stock at Apple, so you won’t want to sleep on this if you’re interested – it is the most affordable price for an M5 MacBook Air after all.

The official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is now offering the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB of RAM and 512GB of storage down at $1,099 shipped. As mentioned above, it is, at the time of writing, available on the Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue colorways.

The is a regularly $1,299 machine sitting at $200 off the new list price.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (Reg. $1,299 new)
  • Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue

As a quick reminder, all units for the official Apple renewed shop include the following:

  • Apple’s one-year limited warranty
  • Apple’s 14-day returns policy
  • AppleCare eligibility
  • Apple’s Rigorous refurbishment process prior to sale

For comparison’s sake, Amazon is charging very close to the $1,299 MSRP on this model in new condition, with the Silver variant down at $1,240.

Amazon still offering a solid $400 off these M5 Pro MacBook Pro configs

As part of its 60th Anniversary sale, yesterday Best Buy hosted a special 1-day Apple sale event. The featured deal was a solid $400 off a pair of M5 Pro MacBook Pro configs, but Amazon still has both of these deals live today if you missed out.

Amazon is still offering both of these 14-inch 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro at $400 off the list price – one with the base CPU/GPU spec and one with the upgraded 18-Core/12-Core setup.

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,599 (Reg. $2,999)
    • 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,799 (Reg. $3,199)
    • 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU

These are indeed the same deals we featured yesterday, but they also very much looked as though they might only last for 1-day – Best Buy said they would and there was no way to know if Amazon would follow suit. All things considered, Amazon could shut these deals down at any moment, but they are still live at the time of writing and we wanted to make sure they were on the radar for folks.

This 48GB 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro is $400 off today

B&H is now offering Apple’s 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 48GB of RAM and 1TB of storage capacity down at $2,699 shipped.

This is a $3,099 configuration at $400 off the price it would cost to score it straight from Apple.

Apple Watch Series 11 $100 off for Anniversary week, Best Buy open-box offers from $254

While yesterday’s 24-hour 60th Anniversary Apple sale is now long gone, there are still some serious deals flying. Alongside AirPods Pro 3 at 25% off, AirPods Max 2 at $120 off, and return all-time lows on Apple’s latest AirTag 2, we are also tracking some notable $100 price drops on all of the most affordable Apple Watch Series 11 models at Amazon and Best Buy – you’ll even find models down as low as $254 in “excellent” open-box condition.

Amazon is once again offering all of the base model 46mm Series 11 models down at $329 shipped. That’s $100 off the $429 list price and you’ll find all four case colors down at the discounted rate.

Its stock on the smaller and less pricey 42mm, however, is all but entirely depleted right now. This is where Best Buy comes in.

It is in the midst of its giant 60th Anniversary Sale this week and it does have all of the 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 models both in stock and on sale at $100 off the list price.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (Reg. $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (Reg. $429)

While not a massive difference in price, I also wanted to point out this “excellent” condition open-box offer on the Jet Black 42mm model – you can score it down at $253.99 shipped, or $145 off the new list price. That is only $45 less than buying one brand new right now, but $45 is not insignificant and it is the lowest price we can find from a reputable source.

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new)

  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,179 (Reg. $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (Reg. $1,299 new)

As detailed in yesterday top picks from the Apple refurb store feature, you can land a perfectly capable iPhone 16 model with a 1-year Apple warranty starting from $699 and a 1TB 16 Pro Max at $1,269 – $330 less than the comparable 17 Pro Max, and $130 less than the 512GB 17 Pro.

  • Refurbished iPhone 16 from $699 (Up to $330 less than series 17)

Twelve South Curve Nano is one of the best looking MagSafe stands I’ve seen, bag it for $27 (Reg. $35)

Today’s accessories and charging deals:

  • Twelve South’s all-in-one braided PowerCord USB-C Charger now down at $16.50 (45% off)
  • 5TB for just $180? Rare deal drops WD’s Elements portable drive to its lowest price since the storage hikes (Today only)
  • Score Keychron mechanical keyboards from just $20 in Woot’s latest sale with deals at up to 64% off

  • Govee’s latest Floor Lamp 3 Lite with Matter down at $85, or save up to 47% on other models from $80
  • Anker’s Nano 100W 3-Port Charger comes with a 5-foot cable down at $36 today

Amazon now has AirPods Max 2 in all five colors at $120 off (One of the best prices ever)

This week’s giant 60th Anniversary sale is ushering in one of the best prices to date on Apple’s 2026 AirPods Max 2, and Amazon now has all five colors at $120 off the list price.

Amazon is now offering Apple’s AirPods Max 2 down at $429 shipped.

Carrying the same $549 as the previous-generation set, you’re looking at a solid $120 in savings here to deliver the best price we can find right now in brand new condition from a reputable retailer.

Best Buy does have the Midnight black set down at $403.99 shipped in “excellent” open-box condition, and that is a lower price, but perhaps not quite enough lower to side-step a brand new set.

Apple unleashed a proper next-generation set of AirPods Max this year, as opposed to just a fresh coat of paint and the USB-C jack on the previous release. Unlike the in-ear AirPods lineup, it is not going to update is over-ear options as part of next month’s new releases, so we are looking at $120 off what could be the latest and greatest Apple over-ears for some time here this week.

There has only been one other sale event to offer them for less, and that was Prime Day earlier this summer that had them selling for $30 under the deal price we have here today – stock was also rather limited and unreliable during the 4-day sale as well.

Anker’s 45W Nano Smart Display charger is still down at $26 low, but this bundle adds a USB-C cable for just $4 more

As part of its ongoing 60th Anniversary sale event, Best Buy is offering Anker’s 45W Nano Smart Display charger in white bundled with a Nano USB-C cable for $29.99 shipped. That’s only about $4 more than the charger’s current $25.99 shipped discounted price, which it’s still fetching at both Amazon and Best Buy. You’re looking at a really good value here, considering the Nano USB-C cable bundled here normally goes for around $18, which you’re essentially adding to the charger for just $4. Head below for more details.

  • Anker Nano 45W GaN charger with Smart Display $25.99 (Reg. $40)
  • Black
  • Blue
  • Orange
  • White

Anker’s 45W Nano charger remains a popular unit with its built-in Smart Display, which can recognize supported devices like iPhones and iPad Pro models and adjust power delivery accordingly. The screen also shows live charging information and animations, so you can quickly see what’s happening while your device is plugged in. You get a single top-mounted USB-C port with up to 45W output, along with 180-degree folding prongs that make the charger easy to pack for everyday use or travel. Anker offers it in four colors, including an orange finish that pairs nicely with Apple’s Cosmic Orange devices. This particular listing bundles the charger with Anker’s Nano USB-C cable for just $4 more. The braided cable supports up to 240W charging and 480Mb/s data transfer, making it a pretty good option overall and a solid value if you were also looking to buy a new and reliable cable to charge your phone.

Other notable Anker deals

  • Anker Prime 3-in-1 25W Qi2.2 Charging Station with display $135 (Reg. $230)
